sourceFile: 17. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test improve NG function Bako  date 2025.12.03_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable test evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are too broad and omit key normal baseline rows.
issues: Changed factor combines many distinct process/JIG/UV trials into one vague comparison.
Baseline is marked not explicit despite multiple Normal rows in the source context.
Several relevant result rows are omitted, especially later Normal and improvement trials.
Bako 12-hour recheck sheet may be follow-up outcome, not the same comparison set.
Measurement outcome is derived from table headers/aggregates and is not valid row evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the Normal rows be treated as the baseline for all trial conditions?
Should the 12-hour Bako recheck sheet remain in this same review case or be a separate follow-up?
correctionPlan: Regroup by specific trial condition versus Normal baseline, preserving date/order context.
Add all relevant result rows, including Normal repeats and later improvement/JIG/UV trials.
Separate or clearly label the 12-hour recheck as follow-up evidence.
Remove the unsupported measurement-stat outcome from header row data.
Update evidenceRows to cite only rows supporting each condition and metric.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but coverage and assignment are insufficient for final evidence.
